patch_description: Structural redesign around two bottlenecks identified from prior generations. (1) The convex hull area — the ratio denominator evaluated at every hill-climb step — was computed by a pure-Python monotone chain with Python-level loops; it is replaced by `scipy.spatial.ConvexHull` (qhull, C speed) with a vectorized numpy fallback. (2) The solver is reorganized into a `Solver` class encapsulating an incremental state (cached 286-triangle area array + cached hull area): moving point i touches only its ~66 triangles, and the hull area is recomputed only when the moved point is (or becomes) a hull vertex; otherwise the cached denominator is reused. These savings are reinvested in more hill-climb and basin-hopping iterations inside the same wall-clock budget, converting speed directly into solution quality while keeping full determinism (fixed seeds, fixed iteration counts, identical input/output contract).
